settings.overviewDescription: No matter how many Custom-Roles a User qualifies for, they can only ever create 1 Custom-Role. However if they qualify for multiple Custom-Roles and one of them allows them to set an Icon and/or Color while the other doesn't, they will be able to set an Icon and/or Color

sections.reward: Who qualifies for this Reward, and what they get for it.
sections.customRole: The Custom-Role perk this Reward unlocks, and what its owner may change about it.

descriptions.active: Whether this Reward is evaluated at all. Turning it off revokes every perk it granted.
descriptions.roles: Holding any one of these Roles qualifies a Member for this Reward.
descriptions.denyRoles: Holding any one of these Roles disqualifies a Member, even if they hold a qualifying Role. Deny lists apply to keeping a perk, not only to gaining it.
descriptions.denyUsers: These Users never qualify for this Reward, even while holding a qualifying Role.
descriptions.xpMultiplier: Multiplies the XP qualifying Members earn. Two changes against the old behaviour: reward multipliers are now averaged together with your Role multipliers and the result multiplies the roll, instead of being summed and added to the server multiplier; and the multiplier now also applies to Voice XP and to a Member's very first message, neither of which it reached before.
descriptions.notifyChannel: Where the unlock notification is posted. Leave empty to send it as a DM instead.
descriptions.customRole: Whether qualifying Members may own a Custom-Role. A Member only ever owns one, no matter how many Rewards they qualify for.
descriptions.canSetColor: Whether the owner may pick a solid colour for their Custom-Role.
descriptions.canSetIcon: Whether the owner may set an icon on their Custom-Role. Requires the Role Icons Server feature.
descriptions.canSetGradient: Whether the owner may set a two-colour gradient. Requires the Enhanced Role Colors Server feature.
descriptions.canSetHolo: Whether the owner may set the holographic style. Requires the Enhanced Role Colors Server feature.
descriptions.positionRole: The Custom-Role is kept directly below this Role. When several Rewards apply, the highest of their anchors wins.
descriptions.maxShare: How many other Members the owner may share their Custom-Role with, 0 to 25. Lowering this drops the most recently added Members first and strips the Role from them.
